answer.reason: The verses tell of Amasa's appointment by Absalom, David's pledge to make him captain, and his killing, though the killing by Joab is already in the summary.

clauses.english: was made captain of the host by Absalom in place of Joab
clauses.quote: Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab

clauses.english: was told by David to assemble the men of Judah, but tarried past the set time
clauses.quote: Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time

doubts: The killing by Joab (2SA 20:8-12, 1KI 2:5, 1KI 2:32) is already stated in the summary, so it is left out.
David's message in 2SA 19:13 is a promise to make him captain, not an event, so it is not a clause.
1CH 2:17 only gives his parentage, so it is not used.
